newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Corp to name president - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Corp to name president - WSJ.

text.p: Frontier Corp is expected to name Joseph Clayton president and likely heir apparent to their chairman and chief executive who late last year underwent emergency brain surgery, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the telecommunications company is expected to announce the appointment later today.

Chairman and Chief Executive Ronald Bittner has resumed his full duties since having surgery to remove a brain tumor. However, concerns among directors about his health prompted the company to search for an executive who could succeed Bittner within a year, a source told the Journal.
The position of president at Frontier has been vacant since November 1995.
Most recently, Clayton was Thomson SA's highest-ranking U.S. official until December, when he resigned after a lengthy career in consumer electronics.
Bittner is likely to remain chairman once Clayton succeeds him as chief executive, the Journal said.
